assumptions: \(d,n\in\mathbb N,\ 3\le n\le d,\ \kappa\ge4\); set \(k=\lfloor d/n\rfloor\) and \(r=d-kn=d\bmod n\). Both endpoint inequalities are inclusive.

For normalized full orthogonal Haar probability \(\mu_n\), let \(\nu_\pm=2\mu_n|_{\{\det O=\pm1\}}\). Define \(A_O=\frac{\kappa+1}{2}I-\frac{\kappa-1}{4}(O+O^\top)\), \(\mathcal D_\pm=(\boldsymbol O\mapsto\operatorname{diag}(A_{O_1},\ldots,A_{O_k},I_r))_\#\nu_\pm^{\otimes k}\), and the actual averaged targets \(\bar\pi_\pm=\int\mathcal N(0,A^{-1})\,d\mathcal D_\pm(A)\). Each product uses one common sign.

Use the actual block density representatives \(p_\pm(x)=\int \sqrt{\det A_O}(2\pi)^{-n/2}e^{-x^\top A_Ox/2}\,d\nu_\pm(O)\), and \(a=\int_{\mathbb R^n}\sqrt{p_+(x)p_-(x)}\,dx\). Actual Gaussian validity, Haar-average inner L1, nonnegativity, measurability and normalization are supplied internally by canonical producers.

All base measures are canonical Euclidean Lebesgue volume. Put \(R_\pm=d\bar\pi_\pm/dx\). The exact Lean integrand is \(F(x)=\sqrt{\operatorname{toReal}(R_+(x))\operatorname{toReal}(R_-(x))}\). RN derivatives are a.e. representatives. Actual Ex70 densities prove their finite a.e. identification, so neither the RN nonexistence default nor the totalized \(\operatorname{toReal}(\infty)=0\) changes the asserted integral.

The literal contiguous split sends ambient volume to the product block/residual volumes. For \(r>0\), the common residual factor is \(\varphi_r(z)=(2\pi)^{-r/2}e^{-\lVert z\rVert^2/2}\). For \(r=0\), its sole vector has unit volume and \(\varphi_0=1\), realizing the source omitted-factor convention. No positive-remainder premise, supplied density identity or supplied affinity-integrability premise is added.

obligations.label: Actual Gaussian-mixture RN-affinity is genuinely integrable and equals the exact block affinity power.

bindings.boundary: Actual Ex71 tensorization, genuine L1 and absolute continuity only. Tests combine it with the existing single-block bound to give actual-law affinity decay. Actual Ex72 TV, determinant-sign exact-matvec/transcript/TV-precision/deterministic worst-case query-cap and explicit expected-cost adapters, fixed-spectrum hidden eigenbasis and both main lower bounds remain open. Independent source verification, root/site integration, remote publication, postmerge purification/Exposition Seal and whole Goal are separate phases.
